finding: Women with PTSD symptoms had significantly worse quality of life at 4-6 weeks postpartum, and factors such as birth type, analgesia methods, and humanizing practices were associated with PTSD risk.
mod_finding: Instrumental birth and cesarean section were found to be risk factors for PTSD (aOR: 2.50; 95%CI: 1.70, 3.69 and aOR: 3.79; 95%CI: 2.43, 5.92, respectively).
